description: This file is the entry point for a React-based frontend web application. It initializes the React DOM rendering process by mounting the main 'App' component into a DOM element with the ID 'root'. It also imports necessary dependencies such as React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into a specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the created root.
